title: The held letter on Tonight
note: The Keep sheet said the letter waits on Tonight, and it does: its own card, with the words as typed, says "Waiting to be kept." and "Keep it".
text: Asha · 0 days Good morning, Mama. What does Asha's face do while sleeping? Another thought Saturday You waved at the dog on the corner. Waiting to be kept. Keep it Speak Type Tonight Book Family You can write whenever you like.
lines: What does Asha's face do while sleeping?
You waved at the dog on the corner.
You can write whenever you like.
